title: A girl's first visit to the gynecologist
what: This is your daughter's first meeting with a gynecologist. Most often it is a talk and an outside exam, without instruments.
why: When periods start, for an irregular cycle, pain, discharge, or for a routine checkup.
tell_doctor: When her periods started and what they are like
If she has pain, discharge, or itching

prepare.title: Talk
prepare.text: Calmly explain to your daughter ahead of time what will happen. Tell her she can ask questions and say "stop".

prepare.title: Hygiene
prepare.text: In the morning, she should shower, without scented products.

prepare.title: Diary
prepare.text: Write down her period dates, if they have started.

steps: The doctor gets to know your daughter and talks with her and with you
Sometimes the parent is asked to step out briefly so your daughter can talk openly
Height and weight are measured, and the breasts are checked
The genitals are checked from the outside
If needed, an ultrasound through the belly is ordered
The doctor explains the results and gives advice
feel: Your daughter may feel embarrassed. This is normal
The outside exam does not hurt
The doctor explains each step before doing it
after: Praise your daughter and talk about how it went
Do any tests the doctor ordered
Come back as the doctor schedules
red_flags: Severe belly pain: call emergency services
Very heavy periods, weakness, or dizziness
No periods by age 15: make an appointment with a doctor

faq.q: At what age should a girl first see a gynecologist?
faq.a: Usually when periods start or around age 13 to 15. Earlier if something worries you.

faq.q: Will she be examined on the exam chair?
faq.a: Girls usually have only an outside exam. Nothing is done without her consent.

reminders.text: Your daughter's gynecologist visit is tomorrow. Calmly tell her what will happen.
